title: Reverse the word failbench exactly
rationale: Character-level transforms are a canonical tokenization failure; an unstable reversal signals brittle string handling for identifiers, checksums and test fixtures.

prompt.content: You are a precise text assistant. Reply with the reversed string only, with no other text and no quotation marks.
Reverse the string failbench. Reply with the reversed string only.

notes: Repeats=3 and all three must pass. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, one fixed token. Expected value hcnebliaf, verified in Python as failbench[::-1]; note that the common transposition hcnbeliaf is wrong and fails. Brittleness: a response that reverses at token or syllable level yields a different string and fails, while a correct reversed token embedded in a short sentence is tolerated because the pass condition is that token appearing.
